nodes.label: LightDebug.vert
nodes.rationale: Vertex shader for the cheat-menu light/shadow debug line overlay; pulls its own vertex positions and colors from uniform arrays by gl_VertexIndex.

nodes.label: Vertex pulling from uniform arrays
nodes.rationale: Line endpoints live in uniform arrays indexed by gl_VertexIndex instead of a vertex buffer, because BaseProject::createBuffer() is reachable only through Starter.hpp's fixed friend list and Starter.hpp is off-limits to edit.

nodes.label: vec4 arrays to match std140 16-byte stride
nodes.rationale: std140 pads an array of vec3 to a 16-byte stride anyway, so the arrays are declared vec4 up front with w as unused padding to avoid a layout mismatch with the C++ side.

nodes.label: Light/shadow debug line overlay
nodes.rationale: Cheat-menu-gated wireframe visualization of light gizmos and shadow frustums, with a fixed draw vertex count and per-frame re-filled position/color arrays.
